newsitem.title: CONGO: Brazzaville enjoys second day of relative calm.
newsitem.headline: Brazzaville enjoys second day of relative calm.

text.p: Congo's divided capital Brazzaville enjoyed a second morning of relative calm on Sunday as its pro- and anti-president factions observed a new ceasefire.
Witnesses said some isolated shooting continued but there was none of the heavy shelling that had thundered around the capital for several days last week.
Earlier truces have dampened but not put an end to the three-week-old conflict between supporters of President Pascal Lissouba and former military leader Denis Sassou Nguesso.

Hundreds of people have died since the fighting began on June 5. Efforts to broker a political solution, centred around conditions for fresh presidential elections, due on July 27 but postponed by the fighting, have made little progress.
